purpose: Test the transmissibility theory of teacher-to-student handover: a mode-seeking student restarted at level tau keeps a committed teacher's minority prosodic mode with probability at most Phi((A - beta) / B), a ceiling that more teacher steps cannot raise and that a later restart level raises
theory: two prosodic modes at +/-m with dominant weight pi; teacher log-odds l_k = log(pi/(1-pi)) + 2 m t x_t/(1-t)^2, estimate m tanh(l_k/2); handover y = tau * estimate + (1-tau) * fresh noise; student keeps the dominant mode iff beta + A tanh(l_k/2) + B eps' > 0 with A = 2 m^2 tau^2/(1-tau)^2, B = 2 m tau/(1-tau); retention ceiling R* = Phi((A - beta)/B)

arms.W4: student restarted at tau1 = 0.0761 from the Step-4 estimate (13 passes)
arms.W8: student restarted at tau1 from the Step-8 estimate: the 0.25 reference (21)
arms.W4R2: student restarted at tau2 = 0.2929 from the Step-4 estimate (12)
arms.W8R2: student restarted at tau2 from the Step-8 estimate (20)
arms.T16: the guided teacher alone, run to t = 1 on the released 16-interval grid (32)
arms.shared: all five arms come from one teacher trajectory per seed; the student loop is the released one (STUDENT_TAUS for tau1, STUDENT_TAUS[1:] for tau2)

data.diversity: the first 20 EXP-012 Quick-set development speakers, clean prompts, 20 seeds (input_seed + 1000 + m), EXP-020's seeds; CVf0 across seeds of each arm
data.quality: the first 40 speakers, clean, synthesis seed = input seed; W4R2, W8R2 and T16 scored against the stored reference (EXP-018)

hypotheses.H1: CVf0(T16) - CVf0(W8), speaker bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
hypotheses.H2: CVf0(W8R2) - CVf0(W8) lower bound > 0, and the mean absolute CVf0 gap to T16 is smaller for W8R2 than for W8
hypotheses.H4_exploratory: Spearman correlation across speakers between CVf0(T16) - CVf0(W8) and CVf0(T16) - stored CVf0(student alone): positive under the theory (a more biased student loses more)

verdict_rule: supported if H1 and H2 hold; refuted if H1 fails (the reference keeps the pure teacher's variety, so there is no ceiling to explain); mixed otherwise. Supported: design an algorithm aimed at the ceiling. Refuted: drop the theory's central prediction. No retuning on these data
power: on EXP-020's 20 clean speakers the speaker-bootstrap 95% half-width of a CVf0 difference was 0.0016 between two handovers from the same teacher trajectory (plain_8 - plain_4), 0.0083 for Voice-Swap against the reference and 0.0215 for the student alone against the reference; smaller differences may go undetected
smoke: 2 cases (Quick-set positions 59-60): the teacher loop matches the released teacher at Steps 4 and 8 (max abs <= 0.0001) and the stored W4 and W8 scores are reproduced (tolerance 0.01); in the full run, the released W4 and W8 CVf0 are compared with EXP-020's stored values
novelty: the theory is the candidate contribution: no published two-model analysis or retention ceiling for a biased student after re-noising was found (searches 2026-11-14; closest: speciation theory for one model, empirical first-step diversity papers, reflection coupling in speculative sampling); not certified
evidence_status: development test of a theory on speakers that designed earlier experiments; not evidence for a method
adoption: not adopted; changing the thesis method needs a dated decision record and adviser review
hardware: Colab Tesla T4 only; Shonget-DMOSpeech2 at the pinned commit
